Look, I’m not much for long speeches, so I’ll keep this short. You people have been incredible. When I started, I didn’t know half of you; now I can’t imagine doing this without you. We’ve stayed late, we’ve argued about fonts, we’ve been through budget cuts and surprise deadlines and a fire drill that turned into a two-hour lunch. And every time, you pulled it together. I’ve learned more from this team than I could ever teach. Thank you for the long nights, the sharp questions, and the laughter that got us through. Whatever comes next, I hope we keep in touch. Now, let’s get some cake before it disappears — I’m told there’s a lot of it.
